label: RT60
name: Reverberation time
definition: The time required for sound energy in an enclosed space to decay by 60 dB after the source stops. Used to characterise the acoustic quality of auditoria, halls and performance venues.

label: STI
name: Speech transmission index
definition: A standardised metric for speech intelligibility. It evaluates the effect of noise, reverberation, sound masking, filtering and signal degradation on speech clarity.
range: Rated on a scale from 0 to 1.

label: ALCONS
name: Articulation loss of consonants
definition: The percentage of consonants a listener does not perceive correctly, indicating speech clarity within a space.
range: 0% is excellent intelligibility with no consonant loss; around 10% indicates reduced clarity; 15% is generally the upper limit of acceptable articulation loss.

label: NRC
name: Noise reduction coefficient
definition: A single-number rating of a material's sound absorption, averaged across mid-frequency octave bands. Determined in a reverberation chamber to ASTM C423 / ISO 354.
range: 0.0 reflects effectively all incident sound; 0.5 absorbs about half; 1.0 absorbs most of it.

label: NC
name: Noise criteria
definition: Background noise measured in 1/1-octave bands and plotted against the standard NC curves from 63 Hz to 8000 Hz to evaluate overall noise acceptability.
